    ## Problem Error messages in the Keelwater platform are misleading customers.     signal pass: The claim is that Keelwater's error messages mislead customers into thinking a system bug occurred when the real cause is the customer's own network failure. The root cause of the failure may be the customer's network, but the signal is about the product's misleading messaging, which is actionable. The evidence is thin (one quote), but it is consistent with the problem statement.

    faithfulness pass: I checked the quoted evidence ('the error message makes it sound like a bug') against the cited insight, and it matches exactly. I verified the numbers against the fact sheet: 1 account, 1 mention, 1 route (support), ARR of £1,600,000 for Marrowgate Commercial, 1 renewal in the last 90 days, feedback date 2026-10-27, and renewal date 2026-12-12 — all are accurate. The scope claims ('mentioned 1 time in total', 'based on 1 account') correctly reflect the single cited support mention, and no contrary evidence exists. The characterization of Marrowgate as a 'significant account' is a reasonable inference from its £1.6M ARR and is not overstated.

    duplicate pass: The problem is misleading error messages that blame system bugs when the user's network is at fault. I checked the five most similar items: Shortcut stories 4135 (claim display), 4134 (task list), and 4131 (workspace administration, completed) address unrelated areas; the Notion October release notes mention 'enhanced error logging for user troubleshooting' but that is logging, not clarifying error attribution to network failures; the policyholder notifications page is unrelated. No completed story or roadmap item covers this core problem, and all similarity scores are very low.

Duplicate Claims from Multiple Channels

## Problem When a policyholder reports the same incident through multiple channels, such as phone and web portal, the Keelwater system creates separate, duplicate claims without alerting users. This duplicate loss report scenario causes confusion in financial reserves, reporting, and supplier coordination because the duplicates go undetected at intake. ## Who is affected - **Claims and support teams** who must manually cross-check claims because the system does not flag potential duplicates, consuming time that could be spent on supplier coordination or reporting [i:1e580d536eb9e7c2]. - **Staff across customer accounts** who receive no system warning when a matching incident already exists, leading to separate claims for the same event [i:6f58319920963914][i:770a21dd38be8e96]. - **Teams across onboarding, sales, and support routes** who have reported this issue, indicating it affects multiple points of customer interaction [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:2c50b8970e846b52]. ## Evidence The problem has been reported by 7 accounts in 15 mentions across 3 routes: onboarding (3 mentions), sales (3 mentions), and support (9 mentions) [i:dc8f04a38773b0c3][i:e662b0d940a820b4][i:847e58c1a543471c]. - Pendleford Motor Mutual states, "When a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert us — it just creates two separate claims, which is a classic duplicate loss report scenario and causes confusion in reserves and reporting." [i:055ee693c115b5fa]. - Sallowmere Motor reports, "same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, and now we’ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it." [i:0990586a589ee5d4]. - Tarnholt Drive Cover explains they are "manually cross‑checking every new claim to avoid the same claim twice, which eats up time we could spend on supplier coordination or reporting." [i:1e580d536eb9e7c2]. - Ravensgill Insurance mentions "we’re getting the same claim ... when ... portal … no alert ... at intake" [i:2c50b8970e846b52]. - Orrinbury Fleet Insurance notes, "policyholder reported the same incident both over the phone and through the web portal, and it created two separate claims without any alert." [i:6f58319920963914]. - Hollinbrook Home Insurance says, "We’ve seen the same loss reported through two channels — phone and web — and no system warning appeared, creating a duplicate loss report that complicates our reserves and payments." [i:7572aacb13bfbab0]. - Callowfield Auto Assurance reports "we’ve had several instances where the same loss gets reported twice — once by phone, once via web — and the system doesn’t warn us... it creates duplicate claims and messes up our reserves and reporting." [i:b658a07ed97377d2]. These accounts represent a total ARR of £5,220,000.0 [i:dc8f04a38773b0c3]. Two renewals have occurred in the last 90 days [i:dc8f04a38773b0c3]. ## Why now The issue is a persistent operational inefficiency that directly impacts financial accuracy and resource allocation. With a combined ARR of £5,220,000.0 from the affected accounts, the risk of inaccurate reserves and reporting due to undetected duplicates represents a material financial exposure [i:dc8f04a38773b0c3]. Furthermore, two accounts (Tarnholt Drive Cover and Hollinbrook Home Insurance) have renewals upcoming on 2027-01-09 and 2027-01-15 respectively, and a third (Pendleford Motor Mutual) renews on 2027-02-28, making this a timely concern for customer retention and value demonstration [i:dc8f04a38773b0c3].

  • help_article (draft): # Activity Timeline Display The Activity Timeline provides a chronological, scrollable view of key events, user actions, and system updates for each claim, helping you track cases and maintain accountability. **How to use the Activity Timeline** 1. **Wait for the announced release bundle** – The feature ships in a scheduled release bundle that is announced on our published cadence. 2. **Enable the feature flag** – Your system administrator must switch on the Activity Timeline feature flag after the bundle is deployed. 3. **Open a claim** – Navigate to the claim you want to review in Keelwater. 4. **Locate the Activity Timeline** – The timeline appears as a scrollable panel within the claim view, typically positioned near the bottom or side of the screen. 5. **Scroll through events** – Use the scroll bar or mouse wheel to move through the chronological list of events, which includes system updates, user actions, and other key milestones. 6. **Review details** – Click on an individual entry to see additional information about that event, if available. *When the release bundle is announced and the feature flag is turned on for your organization, the Activity Timeline will become available in the claim view.*
  • help_article (draft): # Payment History Improvements The new payment history view provides a clearer, more detailed display of transactions, refunds, and adjustments, with improved timestamps and categorization to support faster reconciliation. **How to use the enhanced payment history** 1. **Open the Payments section** – From the main navigation, select **Payments** and then click **History**. 2. **Select the desired date range** – Use the date picker to specify the period you want to review. 3. **Apply filters** – Choose filters such as **Transaction Type**, **Refund**, or **Adjustment** to narrow the list. 4. **Review detailed entries** – Each line now shows precise timestamps and clear categorization, making it easy to identify each activity. 5. **Export or reconcile** – Use the **Export** button to download the detailed view for reconciliation or further analysis. > This feature is included in an announced release bundle that follows our regular publishing cadence and is controlled by a feature flag. You will receive the updated payment history view when the bundle is announced and the flag is switched on for your account.
  • help_article (draft): # Workspace Administration Keelwater's workspace administration feature lets you manage permissions, configure settings, and organize teams within your claims environment from a centralized, intuitive dashboard. ### How to use Workspace Administration 1. **Open the Workspace Administration dashboard** – Navigate to the admin section of Keelwater and select *Workspace Administration*. 2. **Manage permissions** – Choose a user or group, then assign or modify their access levels for claims, reports, and other resources. 3. **Configure settings** – Adjust workspace‑wide options such as default claim types, notification preferences, and integration parameters. 4. **Organize teams** – Create, rename, or delete teams; drag and drop users to place them in the appropriate team structures. 5. **Save and apply changes** – Review your modifications and click *Save* to apply them across the workspace. > **Release information**: Workspace Administration ships in an announced release bundle on a published cadence and is controlled by a feature flag. You will receive the feature when the bundle is announced and the flag is switched on.
  • help_article (draft): # Filtering Claims by Date, Status, and Type The Claim Search Refinements feature lets you filter claims by date range, status, and claim type, making it easier to locate specific claims without scrolling through unrelated entries. **How to use the filters** 1. Navigate to the **Claims** page in Keelwater. 2. Click the **Filter** icon or button above the claim list. 3. Choose a **date range** using the calendar picker (optional). 4. Select one or more **status** values from the dropdown menu (optional). 5. Choose a **claim type** from the list of available types (optional). 6. Press **Apply** to view only the claims that match your selected criteria. 7. To remove the filters, click **Clear Filters** or adjust the selections and re‑apply. > **Note:** This capability is part of an announced release bundle and will be available to you once the bundle is announced and the feature flag is switched on for your organization.
  • help_article (draft): ## Supplier Contact Details Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry. 1. **Verify the feature is included in the announced release bundle** – The supplier contact details feature is delivered as part of a scheduled release bundle. 2. **Confirm the feature flag is enabled** – Your system administrator must switch on the feature flag for the bundle to activate the functionality. 3. **Open a claim** – Navigate to the claim where you need supplier information. 4. **Access the supplier section** – The supplier contact fields will be populated automatically from the integrated systems. 5. **Refresh if needed** – If the supplier information changes in the source system, the details will update automatically the next time the claim is opened. 6. **Save the claim** – No manual entry of supplier contact details is required; the updated information is saved with the claim. *The feature becomes available to you when the announced release bundle is shipped and the feature flag is turned on.*

  • help_article (draft): ## Bulk upload documents to a claim Upload multiple documents to a claim in one step, reducing manual effort for claims handlers. 1. **Navigate to the claim** – Open the claim you want to add documents to. 2. **Select the bulk upload option** – Click the *Bulk Upload Documents* button in the claim’s document section. 3. **Choose files** – In the file picker, select all the documents you wish to attach (you can use Shift‑click or Ctrl/Cmd‑click to select multiple files). 4. **Confirm the upload** – Click *Upload* to start the process.  "target_type": "raw_record"
}

How it works

  1. Collect. Every night Keelwater's feedback is collected from calls, tickets and sessions.
  2. Clean. What customers said is kept, with the line before it as context that is never quoted, and idle session time is cut.
  3. Judge relevance. A small fast model decides what is product signal and what is noise, and a person checks a weekly sample of 40 dropped items.
  4. Extract and check. A model pulls out the problem and the customer's exact words, and code checks the words really appear in the source.
  5. Group and rank. Similar problems are grouped, matched to the roadmap and ranked with a formula the PM can read.
  6. Brief and review. The top ones get a cited brief, three judges from another model family check it, and a PM accepts, merges, rejects, parks or sends it to another squad.

 "transcript": [
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 7600,
     "start": 0,
     "text": "Hi Alwen, just checking in \u2014 we\u2019re still waiting on the document upload permissions for our policyholders\u2019 claims portal."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 16000,
     "start": 7600,
     "text": "We\u2019ll need to lock in a time next week for the integration walkthrough \u2014 can Tuesday at 11 work for you?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 24000,
     "start": 16000,
     "text": "Thanks for flagging that, Pellin. I\u2019ll check with our dev team and get back to you by end of day."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 31600,
     "start": 24000,
     "text": "Also, our finance team needs clearer reporting on reserves versus actual payments \u2014 it\u2019s causing delays in supplier reconciliation."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 40800,
     "start": 31600,
     "text": "Understood. We can adjust the reporting module to show reserves and payments side by side \u2014 I\u2019ll set up a demo next week."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 49600,
     "start": 40800,
     "text": "Perfect \u2014 and can we also review the roles assigned to our claims handlers? Some tasks are getting stuck in the queue."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 56400,
     "start": 49600,
     "text": "Absolutely. I\u2019ll pull up your current role matrix and we\u2019ll map out any gaps during the demo."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 63600,
     "start": 56400,
     "text": "One last thing \u2014 are the letters module and integrations with our email system still working as expected?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 72400,
     "start": 63600,
     "text": "Yes, both are fully functional. I\u2019ll include a live walkthrough of those in our session so you can see them in action."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 77200,
     "start": 72400,
     "text": "Sounds good \u2014 looking forward to it. Thanks for your help, Alwen."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 84400,
     "start": 77200,
     "text": "My pleasure, Pellin. I\u2019ll send a calendar invite for Tuesday at 11 with the agenda and prep materials."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 91600,
     "start": 84400,
     "text": "Appreciate you getting back so quickly \u2014 it\u2019s a relief to have someone who understands our claims workflow."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 99200,
     "start": 91600,
     "text": "Glad to hear that \u2014 we\u2019re here to make sure your claims process runs smoothly, from documents to payments."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 104800,
     "start": 99200,
     "text": "Exactly \u2014 especially with how much we rely on accurate reporting and supplier coordination."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 110400,
     "start": 104800,
     "text": "Noted \u2014 we\u2019ll make sure those are front and center in next week\u2019s review."

   "topic": ""

 ]

    "body": "We\u2019re getting renewal price concern from several of our biggest clients\u2014they\u2019re asking why their quotes increased so much, and it\u2019s putting pressure on our retention team.",
    "created_at": 1792059430,
    "id": "4161868f8184-1",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "internal",
     "name": "Bryn Telford",
     "type": "admin"
    },
    "body": "Hi Farrin, thanks for reaching out. I\u2019ll check the pricing logic for those accounts and get back to you shortly.",
    "created_at": 1792059440,
    "id": "4161868f8184-2",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "internal",
     "name": "Bryn Telford",
     "type": "admin"
    },
    "body": "Internal note: Customer escalated due to export mismatch affecting high-ARR renewals. Finance team flagged distrust in reporting figures.",
    "created_at": 1792059448,
    "id": "4161868f8184-3",
    "part_type": "note",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Farrin Fellward",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "Also, our finance team is confused\u2014dashboard totals don\u2019t match what they export, and they\u2019re worried the numbers aren\u2019t reliable for reporting.",
    "created_at": 1792059455,

    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {

     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Farrin Fellward",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "Finance keeps comparing the MI dashboard totals with the CSV export and finds them off\u2014this export figures mismatch is causing distrust in the numbers they use for monthly reporting.",
    "created_at": 1792059464,
    "id": "4161868f8184-5",

    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "bot",
     "name": "Bryn Telford",
     "type": "bot"
    },
    "body": "I\u2019ve escalated your concern to our finance integration team for review.",

     "type": "admin"
    },
    "body": "Understood. I\u2019m escalating this to our finance integration team. They\u2019ll look into the discrepancy between the dashboard and export outputs.",

 },
 "transcript": [
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 9600,
     "start": 0,
     "text": "Hi Alwen, thanks for the demo last week \u2014 we\u2019re still evaluating how Keelwater fits our claims workflow, especially around reserves and supplier payments."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 16400,
     "start": 9600,
     "text": "We\u2019re reviewing the tiered pricing options for claims volume tiers, especially for high-frequency marine clients like us."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 26400,
     "start": 16400,
     "text": "Happy to help, Lirven. Let me know which modules you\u2019d like to explore deeper \u2014 we can tailor the walkthrough to your policyholder reporting needs."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 35600,
     "start": 26400,
     "text": "Actually, one thing came up: our finance team noticed the export figures mismatch with what\u2019s shown in the dashboard, which is causing delays."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 47200,
     "start": 35600,
     "text": "Our finance team\u2019s been flagging that the export figures mismatch with dashboard totals \u2014 it\u2019s causing real delays because they can\u2019t trust which numbers to use for month-end reporting."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 56800,
     "start": 47200,
     "text": "That\u2019s a known issue \u2014 the system currently uses UTC for cutoffs, which can misalign with local UK reporting periods. We\u2019re prioritizing a fix."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 62800,
     "start": 56800,
     "text": "Understood. Can we get a timeline? Our month-end close depends on reconciling those numbers accurately."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 71200,
     "start": 62800,
     "text": "We\u2019re targeting Q1 2027 for the update. In the meantime, I can share a manual reconciliation template to bridge the gap."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 78800,
     "start": 71200,
     "text": "That\u2019d help \u2014 send it over. Also, can we schedule a follow-up to discuss task automation and letter templates?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 85600,
     "start": 78800,
     "text": "Absolutely. I\u2019ll book a slot next week and include our integration specialist to cover your supplier workflows."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 91200,
     "start": 85600,
     "text": "Perfect. Thanks again \u2014 we\u2019re keen to get this live before our peak season."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 100000,
     "start": 91200,
     "text": "You\u2019re welcome. I\u2019ll also include a pricing summary for your volume tier \u2014 let me know if you need a custom quote."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 104000,
     "start": 100000,
     "text": "Appreciate that \u2014 we\u2019ll review it with our procurement team."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 108800,
     "start": 104000,
     "text": "Great. I\u2019ll send the reconciliation template and pricing doc by EOD today."

 "transcript": [
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 15200,
     "start": 0,
     "text": "Hi Alwen, we\u2019ve got a bit of a headache here at Sallowmere Motor \u2014 same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, and now we\u2019ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 26800,
     "start": 15200,
     "text": "Thanks for flagging that, Pellin. I\u2019ll log this as a system behavior issue \u2014 we\u2019re aware of the duplicate loss report problem and it\u2019s on our backlog to fix."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 46000,
     "start": 26800,
     "text": "We\u2019ve got a real issue where the same incident came in both by phone and web portal, and now we\u2019ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it \u2014 that\u2019s what we\u2019re calling a duplicate loss report, and it\u2019s messing up our reserves and supplier coordination."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 53200,
     "start": 46000,
     "text": "Appreciate that. It\u2019s causing real confusion for our adjusters when reserves and payments get split across two records."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 62400,
     "start": 53200,
     "text": "Understood. We\u2019re prioritizing a warning at intake so this doesn\u2019t happen again \u2014 you\u2019re not alone in seeing this duplicate loss report issue."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 70000,
     "start": 62400,
     "text": "Good to hear. For now, can we at least manually merge them without losing any documents or supplier notes?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 85600,
     "start": 70000,
     "text": "Yes, you can \u2014 just assign both claims to the same policyholder and use the tasks tab to consolidate notes. We\u2019ll also add a reporting flag to help track these duplicate loss report cases until the fix is live."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 90800,
     "start": 85600,
     "text": "Thanks, Alwen. That\u2019ll help us keep things clean until the system catches up."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 100800,
     "start": 90800,
     "text": "You\u2019re welcome, Pellin. We\u2019ll keep you posted as we roll out the fix \u2014 your feedback on the duplicate loss report issue is really valuable."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 106800,
     "start": 100800,
     "text": "No problem. Let me know if you need any logs or screenshots from our end."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 116400,
     "start": 106800,
     "text": "Will do \u2014 if you could send over the claim IDs and timestamps for the duplicate loss report, that\u2019d help us reproduce it faster."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 119600,
     "start": 116400,
     "text": "On it. I\u2019ll email those over by EOD."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 127200,
     "start": 119600,
     "text": "Perfect \u2014 thanks again, Pellin. We\u2019re treating this as high priority since it affects reserves, payments, and supplier coordination."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 132800,
     "start": 127200,
     "text": "Glad to hear it. We rely on clean claims and reporting, so this matters."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 141200,
     "start": 132800,
     "text": "Absolutely \u2014 and we\u2019re committed to making sure your team isn\u2019t wrestling with duplicate loss report scenarios any longer than necessary."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  }
 ]

    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "internal",
     "name": "Bryn Telford",

    },
    "body": "Morning Kessra \u2014 thanks for reaching out. I\u2019ll take notes and make sure we address each point.",

    "part_type": "comment",

   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Kessra Keldmere",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "First, our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases.",
    "created_at": 1793174898,
    "id": "90b9184a1801-3",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Kessra Keldmere",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "Our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases \u2014 we need per-team configuration.",
    "created_at": 1793174907,
    "id": "90b9184a1801-4",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Kessra Keldmere",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "Can we schedule a 15-minute call next Tuesday to walk through these issues?",
    "created_at": 1793174918,
    "id": "90b9184a1801-5",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Kessra Keldmere",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "Second, we\u2019re getting the same claim twice when a policyholder reports via phone and then the portal \u2014 no alert pops up at intake.",
    "created_at": 1793174923,
    "id": "90b9184a1801-6",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Kessra Keldmere",
     "type": "user"
    },
    "body": "We\u2019re getting the same claim twice when a policyholder reports via phone and then the portal \u2014 no alert pops up at intake, and it\u2019s causing duplicate records.",
    "created_at": 1793174932,
    "id": "90b9184a1801-7",
    "part_type": "comment",
    "type": "conversation_part"
   },
   {
    "author": {
     "id": "customer",
     "name": "Kessra Keldmere",
     "type": "user"

   "end_time": 24.8,
   "index": 2,
   "raw_text": "No delegate at all \u2014 and it\u2019s causing delays on reserve updates that need sign-off before we can process payments.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Gellin Glenmere",

    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 37.2,
   "index": 3,
   "raw_text": "I see \u2014 so when a reserve change exceeds the handler\u2019s authority, it lands in one approver\u2019s queue with no fallback, and claims stall until they return. That\u2019s a known bottleneck.",

   "speaker_name": "Deryn Pell",
   "start_time": 24.8,

   "raw_text": "Exactly \u2014 it\u2019s creating a backlog on the approval waiting list, and policyholders are starting to ask why payments are delayed.",

   "start_time": 37.2,
   "text": "Exactly \u2014 it\u2019s creating a backlog on the approval waiting list, and policyholders are starting to ask why payments are delayed."

    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 60.0,
   "index": 5,
   "raw_text": "We\u2019re seeing claims held up because when a reserve change exceeds authority, it sits in one approver\u2019s queue with no delegate, and that creates a backlog on the approval waiting list \u2014 policyholders are noticing delays.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Gellin Glenmere",
   "start_time": 45.6,
   "text": "We\u2019re seeing claims held up because when a reserve change exceeds authority, it sits in one approver\u2019s queue with no delegate, and that creates a backlog on the approval waiting list \u2014 policyholders are noticing delays."

    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 67.2,
   "index": 6,

   "speaker_id": "staff",
   "speaker_name": "Deryn Pell",
   "start_time": 60.0,
   "text": "Understood. We\u2019ll look at adding delegation rules to prevent the reserve authorisation delay from halting claims during absences."

   "raw_text": "Morning Deryn, just wanted to flag a couple of things slowing us down lately.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Nellin Dovemere",
   "start_time": 0.0,
   "text": "Morning Deryn, just wanted to flag a couple of things slowing us down lately."

  {

    "question": true,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 12.8,
   "index": 1,
   "raw_text": "Could we schedule a quick sync next Tuesday? I\u2019ll need to clear my calendar for the claims review.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Nellin Dovemere",
   "start_time": 5.6,
   "text": "Could we schedule a quick sync next Tuesday? I\u2019ll need to clear my calendar for the claims review."

  {

    "pricing": false,
    "question": true,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 18.4,
   "index": 2,
   "raw_text": "Hi Nellin, thanks for reaching out \u2014 happy to help. What\u2019s on your mind?",
   "speaker_id": "staff",
   "speaker_name": "Deryn Pell",
   "start_time": 12.8,
   "text": "Hi Nellin, thanks for reaching out \u2014 happy to help. What\u2019s on your mind?"

  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 26.4,
   "index": 3,
   "raw_text": "First, we\u2019re spending too much time calling garages because we can\u2019t see live repair updates \u2014 it\u2019s a daily grind.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Nellin Dovemere",
   "start_time": 18.4,
   "text": "First, we\u2019re spending too much time calling garages because we can\u2019t see live repair updates \u2014 it\u2019s a daily grind."

   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 38.4,
   "index": 4,
   "raw_text": "We\u2019re spending too much time calling garages because we can\u2019t see live repair updates \u2014 it\u2019s a daily grind, and the repair updates missing is really hurting our workflow efficiency.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Nellin Dovemere",
   "start_time": 26.4,
   "text": "We\u2019re spending too much time calling garages because we can\u2019t see live repair updates \u2014 it\u2019s a daily grind, and the repair updates missing is really hurting our workflow efficiency."

  {
   "ai_filters": {

   },
   "end_time": 44.4,
   "index": 5,
   "raw_text": "That\u2019s a known pain point \u2014 we\u2019re tracking it as \u2018repair updates missing\u2019 for prioritisation.",

   "speaker_name": "Deryn Pell",
   "start_time": 38.4,
   "text": "That\u2019s a known pain point \u2014 we\u2019re tracking it as \u2018repair updates missing\u2019 for prioritisation."
  },
  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false

   "end_time": 51.6,
   "index": 6,
   "raw_text": "Exactly \u2014 and it\u2019s not just annoying, it\u2019s eating into time we could spend on policyholders or tasks.",

   "speaker_name": "Nellin Dovemere",

   "text": "Understood. We\u2019ll log this under \u2018garage progress visibility\u2019 to make sure it\u2019s visible to the product team."

    "task": false

   "end_time": 68.4,
   "index": 8,
   "raw_text": "The lack of real-time visibility into garage progress is forcing us to chase manually \u2014 garage progress visibility is a blocker we need solved ASAP.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Nellin Dovemere",

   "sentences": [

   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [

   "topic": ""
  },
  {

   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [

   "topic": ""
  },

   "sentences": [

   "speakerId": "staff",

  },

   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [

   "topic": ""
  },

   "sentences": [

     "start": 66000,

   "topic": ""

   "sentences": [

   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },

     "start": 78400,

   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""

  {

  },
  {
   "sentences": [

   "sentences": [

  {
   "sentences": [
    {

     "text": "Thanks for reaching out, Nellin. We can walk through how reserves are tied to supplier payments and how reporting reflects that linkage in real time."

   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 26400,

     "text": "That\u2019s exactly what I\u2019m after \u2014 especially how roles affect who can adjust those reserves before payment triggers."

   "speakerId": "customer",

  },

   "sentences": [

   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [

   "topic": ""
  },
  {

     "text": "That\u2019ll be helpful. One last thing \u2014 how are tasks assigned when a claim hits a threshold that requires manual review?"

   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {

 "transcript": [
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 9200,
     "start": 0,
     "text": "Hi Alwen, thanks for jumping on this. We\u2019re drowning in repair updates missing again this week \u2014 it\u2019s eating into our daily tasks."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 18400,
     "start": 9200,
     "text": "We\u2019re stuck calling garages every day because repair updates missing \u2014 it\u2019s a constant drag on our team\u2019s productivity and delays claim resolution."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 26000,
     "start": 18400,
     "text": "Could we schedule a follow-up next Tuesday? I\u2019ll be out Monday but back then to review the reserve adjustments."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 34000,
     "start": 26000,
     "text": "I hear you \u2014 having to call garages manually for status is a real bottleneck. How often does that happen?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 41200,
     "start": 34000,
     "text": "Every single day. We\u2019ve got handlers spending hours on the phone instead of processing claims or managing reserves."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 50400,
     "start": 41200,
     "text": "That\u2019s not sustainable. Let me flag this as a priority for our product team \u2014 we need live repair updates in the system."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 56800,
     "start": 50400,
     "text": "Appreciate that. We\u2019re also struggling with supplier comms and task tracking \u2014 it\u2019s all tied together."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 65200,
     "start": 56800,
     "text": "Understood. I\u2019ll loop in our integrations lead and get a timeline for improvements. Can I send a draft proposal by Friday?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 71600,
     "start": 65200,
     "text": "Yes, please \u2014 and include reporting and letters too. We need full visibility across all touchpoints."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 79600,
     "start": 71600,
     "text": "Will do. I\u2019ll also check if we can assign a dedicated role to monitor supplier status until the fix lands."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 86000,
     "start": 79600,
     "text": "That would help a lot. Thanks for listening \u2014 we\u2019re counting on Keelwater to streamline this."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 94000,
     "start": 86000,
     "text": "Absolutely \u2014 your feedback drives our roadmap. I\u2019ll follow up with a summary and next steps by end of day."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 98000,
     "start": 94000,
     "text": "Perfect. Looking forward to it. Have a good one, Alwen."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 101200,
     "start": 98000,
     "text": "You too, Ilyra. I\u2019ll be in touch soon."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 106800,
     "start": 101200,
     "text": "Quick question \u2014 can we get policyholder comms automated too? It\u2019s another manual task."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 113200,
     "start": 106800,
     "text": "Yes, that\u2019s in our backlog \u2014 I\u2019ll tag it as high-priority alongside the repair status issue."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 119200,
     "start": 113200,
     "text": "Great. We\u2019re swamped with letters and payments too \u2014 anything to reduce that load helps."

   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 124400,

   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""

  {
   "sentences": [
    {

     "text": "Appreciate the quick action. This is exactly why we chose Keelwater \u2014 responsive and solution-focused."

   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 137200,

     "text": "Thank you \u2014 that means a lot. I\u2019ll make sure our team delivers on this for you."

   "raw_text": "You\u2019re welcome, Celdra \u2014 happy to help. Let me know if anything feels unclear as we go.",

   "end_time": 25.2,
   "index": 2,
   "raw_text": "One thing I noticed \u2014 when assigning staff to different claim roles, we can\u2019t seem to map our existing sign-on groups to those roles directly. Is that on the roadmap?",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Celdra Jarrowfell",
   "start_time": 13.2,
   "text": "One thing I noticed \u2014 when assigning staff to different claim roles, we can\u2019t seem to map our existing sign-on groups to those roles directly. Is that on the roadmap?"

  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 39.2,
   "index": 3,
   "raw_text": "When we set up user permissions, we need to link our existing sign-on groups to specific roles in Keelwater \u2014 right now that mapping isn\u2019t available, and it\u2019s causing extra manual work for our team.",
   "speaker_id": "customer",
   "speaker_name": "Celdra Jarrowfell",
   "start_time": 25.2,
   "text": "When we set up user permissions, we need to link our existing sign-on groups to specific roles in Keelwater \u2014 right now that mapping isn\u2019t available, and it\u2019s causing extra manual work for our team."

  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 48.8,
   "index": 4,
   "raw_text": "That\u2019s a valid point \u2014 we\u2019re tracking that as a feature request for future updates. I\u2019ll make sure it\u2019s logged with our product team.",

   "speaker_name": "Carys Fenwick",

   "text": "That\u2019s a valid point \u2014 we\u2019re tracking that as a feature request for future updates. I\u2019ll make sure it\u2019s logged with our product team."

   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,

    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 60.4,
   "index": 5,
   "raw_text": "Also, when we\u2019re uploading evidence for a claim, it\u2019s tedious to add each file one at a time. We\u2019d really benefit from being able to upload multiple files together.",

   "speaker_name": "Celdra Jarrowfell",

   "text": "Also, when we\u2019re uploading evidence for a claim, it\u2019s tedious to add each file one at a time. We\u2019d really benefit from being able to upload multiple files together."

  {
   "ai_filters": {
    "pricing": false,
    "question": false,
    "task": false
   },
   "end_time": 76.0,
   "index": 6,
   "raw_text": "We handle a lot of claims with large volumes of supporting files, and uploading them one by one is slowing us down \u2014 we really need the ability to use multiple file upload to batch-add documents to a claim.",

   "end_time": 90.0,

   "speaker_name": "Carys Fenwick",

   "text": "I understand \u2014 that\u2019s a common request. In fact, we just shipped support for multiple file upload last week. You should now be able to add many documents at once from the claim\u2019s documents tab."

   "speaker_name": "Celdra Jarrowfell",

     "text": "Good morning, Alwen. I\u2019ve been reviewing our claims handling workflows and need clarity on how your system manages reserves and supplier payments together."

  },

  },

      "fields": [],
      "objectId": "18452001031",
      "objectType": "company",
      "timing": "TimeOfCall"
     }
    ],
    "system": "HubSpot"
   }
  ],
  "metaData": {
   "duration": 118,
   "id": "a3cec9c5709c",
   "started": "2026-09-22T12:46:00Z"
  },
  "parties": [
   {
    "affiliation": "Internal",
    "emailAddress": "alwen.dovell@keelwater.example",
    "name": "Alwen Dovell",
    "speakerId": "staff"
   },
   {
    "affiliation": "External",
    "emailAddress": "contact@p1.example",
    "name": "Nellin Dovemere",
    "speakerId": "customer"
   }
  ]
 },
 "transcript": [
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 9200,
     "start": 0,
     "text": "Good morning, Alwen. I\u2019ve been reviewing our claims handling workflows and need clarity on how your system manages reserves and supplier payments together."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 19200,
     "start": 9200,
     "text": "Thanks for reaching out, Nellin. We can walk through how reserves are tied to supplier payments and how reporting reflects that linkage in real time."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 26400,
     "start": 19200,
     "text": "That\u2019s exactly what I\u2019m after \u2014 especially how roles affect who can adjust those reserves before payment triggers."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 35200,
     "start": 26400,
     "text": "Roles are permission-based; only users with financial approver roles can modify reserves, and that change automatically flags the payment task for review."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 43600,
     "start": 35200,
     "text": "Perfect. And can we pull a report that shows all claims with pending letters and their associated policyholders in one view?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 50800,
     "start": 43600,
     "text": "Absolutely \u2014 our reporting module lets you filter by letter status and cross-reference policyholder data without switching screens."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 58800,
     "start": 50800,
     "text": "I appreciate that. We\u2019re evaluating integrations next quarter \u2014 does your platform support API hooks for our legacy document system?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 67600,
     "start": 58800,
     "text": "Yes, we offer documented API endpoints for document ingestion and metadata sync \u2014 I\u2019ll send you the integration guide after this call."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 76000,
     "start": 67600,
     "text": "That\u2019ll be helpful. One last thing \u2014 how are tasks assigned when a claim hits a threshold that requires manual review?"
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 84400,
     "start": 76000,
     "text": "Tasks auto-assign based on role rules and workload balance; you can override manually if needed, and the system logs every reassignment."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 89600,
     "start": 84400,
     "text": "Great. I\u2019ll discuss this with our operations lead and circle back next week."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 97200,
     "start": 89600,
     "text": "Sounds good, Nellin. I\u2019ll follow up with the integration docs and a demo link for your team by Friday."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 103600,
     "start": 97200,
     "text": "Thank you \u2014 that\u2019s exactly the kind of support we need to streamline our claims handling."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 112400,
     "start": 103600,
     "text": "We\u2019re glad to help, Nellin. Let me know if you\u2019d like to schedule a deeper dive into the reporting or integrations modules."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "staff",
   "topic": ""
  },
  {
   "sentences": [
    {
     "end": 118400,
     "start": 112400,
     "text": "I\u2019ll be in touch soon \u2014 thanks again for walking me through everything so clearly."
    }
   ],
   "speakerId": "customer",
   "topic": ""
  }
 ]
}
